definitions.explanation: The percentage or proportion of people absent from school, work, or an event. Used in educational, workplace, and statistical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
examples.english: This class has a low absence rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The absence rate goes up in winter due to colds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}→健康管理：21662_kenkoukanri⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company introduced a health management program to reduce employee absenteeism.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧ (absence) and ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, ratio). Part of the productive X⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ pattern used for statistical rates: ⟦{出席率|しゅっせきりつ}→出席率：16604_shussekiritsu⟧ (attendance rate), {合格率|ごうかくりつ} (pass rate), {離職率|りしょくりつ} (turnover rate), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have a high absence rate
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: to have a low absence rate
- {欠席率|けっせきりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to lower the absence rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出席率|しゅっせきりつ}→出席率：16604_shussekiritsu⟧: attendance rate — the inverse measure; both are commonly tracked in schools and workplaces
- {欠勤率|けっきんりつ}: absenteeism rate (at work) — specifically for workplace absences, while {欠席率|けっせきりつ} is more general
